trustAndSafety.headline: Know who is coming and what happens if something goes wrong.
trustAndSafety.intro: Blokpakt sets clear expectations for customers and providers before a job starts, then keeps a record of the work after it is complete.

items.title: Provider review
items.description: We review provider identity, service experience, references, and the information needed for the services they offer before they join the network.

items.title: License and insurance expectations
items.description: Providers must maintain licenses, permits, and insurance required for their trade and location, and must keep that information current.

items.title: Photo record
items.description: Before-and-after photos document the service area, help confirm completion, and give both sides a shared record of the job.

items.title: Payment protection
items.description: Payment is handled through the booking flow, with a dispute window so customers can report a problem before funds are released.

reporting.title: Need to report a problem?
reporting.description: Use the booking or job-tracking page to describe what happened and attach photos. We review the report, contact the provider when needed, and help document a resolution. For immediate safety emergencies, contact local emergency services first.

bookingFaq.headline: The practical answers, before you commit.

items.question: How does a street batch form?
items.answer: Enter your address to see whether your street is active. When 2 or more homes on the same street request the same service window, the group rate unlocks automatically. You can invite a neighbor from your booking link.

items.question: When am I charged?
items.answer: Bookings are available Monday through Saturday, 8:00 AM–6:00 PM local time. Your payment method is authorized when you book and charged after the service is completed and the required before-and-after photos are uploaded. Any approved add-on must be recorded and confirmed through Blokpakt before it is charged.

items.question: How do I reschedule or cancel?
items.answer: You can reschedule or cancel for free until 24 hours before the scheduled service window. Open your booking or contact support as soon as possible; shorter-notice changes may be subject to the terms shown before confirmation.

items.question: What should I do before the provider arrives?
items.answer: Clear personal items from the work area, secure pets, identify gates and water or power access, and tell us about hazards or restricted areas. Providers can only service areas they can safely access.

items.question: What are common service limitations?
items.answer: Weather, unsafe access, blocked areas, hazardous materials, unusually large quantities, and work outside the selected service scope may require a new quote or an approved add-on. Any overloaded or unusual property condition requires provider photos and the homeowner's online approval before an added charge.
